model.base: original distance and square; original WPI ports sum/difference; earlier butterfly Jaccard for later response; PLUS original 2001-2010 all-plant record count sum/difference and pooled candidate introduced-host richness sum/difference
model.U: GSHHG uniform undirected circuit normalized resistance
model.H: port-indexed candidate introduced larval-host composition Jaccard pooled 2001–2024
model.estimator: original train-only standardized OLS with intercept and clip [0,1]
model.LOIO: 51 held-island folds, 50 test pairs per island, 2550 pair-endpoint predictions per model
model.double_unseen: 15 source-frozen longitude-block pair folds, every 1275 unique pair tested once with both island endpoints withheld

interpretation: Under the exact 51-island later butterfly Jaccard target, uniform marine circuit predictive increment conditional on candidate introduced hosts attenuates markedly after adjusting source-verified host richness and early indexed all-plant recording effort; strict double-unseen increment turns slightly adverse. This does not negate distinct 104-botanical-region alien flora association or original 51-island unadjusted predictive result.
limitations: Original botanical record counts are historical sampling-effort proxies, not native or introduced host identity dated to prior butterfly events
2001–2024 pooled host Jaccard can postdate 2011–2022 butterfly indexing
Same 51 originally selected islands not independent temporal cohort or randomized causal test
LOIO and longitude folds are overlapping ecological clusters; intervals descriptive
Other climate/geographic residual and record-provider confounding remain
Uniform GSHHG electrical resistance is undirected marine topology, NOT actual 2005 ocean currents or vessel voyages
No evidence of verified butterfly colonization or plant-mediated causality
